solutions.title: Partial merge to median
solutions.strategy: Advance two sorted pointers only until the median index is reached.

timeComplexity.explanation: The worst case advances through the combined arrays up to the median region.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only two candidate median values and pointer indices are stored.

solutions.title: Binary partition on smaller array
solutions.strategy: Find a partition where every value on the left side is <= every value on the right side.

timeComplexity.explanation: Binary search runs on the shorter input array.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The algorithm stores only partition indices and boundary values.
